messages:
Maya: FYI a customer reported a short-lived billing spike from streaming + toolcall resume. Repro on staging session `sess-88`.
Liam: Short summary? double provisional or double confirm?
Maya: Double provisional, single confirm. Sequence: prefetch emits provisional when seeing toolcall, client reconnect -> router replays -> router emits another provisional. Tool-runner later confirms once.
Jordan: Do we have any idempotency key today?
Maya: Nope. Provisional rows use different trace ids so ledger can't dedupe.
Liam: Quick mitigation: console should not surface provisional as final charge by default. Hide/collapse under "Pending charges" to avoid customer panic.
Jordan: Long-term: generate idempotency key in tool-runner (HMAC of payload+session) and have prefetch/router forward it. Ledger can dedupe on that key.
Maya: Also need confirm to reconcile proactively: if confirm token_count != provisional_token_count, treat confirm as authoritative and replace provisional amount (upsert) instead of additive.
Liam: That will change interim reporting; loop in finance. For rollout: feature-flag idemp header; ledger only dedupes when key present.
ops-bot: ledger-canary start -> 6180001150
Jordan: Metrics: emit tokens.provisional{origin}, tokens.confirmed and alert when provisional/confirmed > 1.4 for 5m. Add console column for provisional_origin so SRE can triage.
Maya: I'll open a tracking ticket + tiny e2e test that simulates prefetch + router provisional then single confirm.
Liam: Sounds good. Post PR links here once ready.
ops-bot: router-canary flags enabled -> 6180001210
